summary: Russia struck Kyiv's Northern Bridge for the second time (Oct 3 and Oct 4), damaging road surface and trolleybus network and disrupting military cargo movements. Ukraine's Zelensky pledged intensified strikes on Russian oil refineries in response; RF MoD vowed retaliation against Kyiv military targets. Multiple reactive drone and missile attacks hit Kyiv, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kirovohrad, and other regions.
key_points: Northern Bridge Kyiv struck twice, road surface and trolleybus network damaged, traffic blocked, military cargo transport disrupted (Source: @UkraineNow/84465, @ukr_leaks_eng/33717)
Zelensky pledged intensified strikes on Russian oil refineries; FP-9 ballistic missile reaching Moscow expected autumn 2026 (Source: @UkraineNow/84477, @UkraineNow/84470)
VSF fighting for Varvarovka, Nikolaevka, Lobanovka, Reznikov in Kharkiv encirclement; enemy occupied Ivanivka, advanced to Novo-Shakhove and Kotlyne (Source: @tass_agency/398726, @DeepStateUA/23880)
Geran-5 cruise missiles struck Northern Bridge Kyiv and Brovary district; Banderol drones hit Kropyvnytskyi, Kremenchuk, Oleksandria, Novyi Bug (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76046, @eRadarrua/120022)
RF drone struck enterprise in Temryuk Krasnodar Krai, 3 injured; drones hit Khanskaya airfield Adygea, Su-34/Su-27 based there in 2024 (Source: @tass_agency/398715, @UkraineNow/84471)
6 injured including 3 children in Belgorod residential strikes; RF MoD vows intensified strikes on Kyiv military targets (Source: @tass_agency/398717, @tass_agency/398718)
Ukraine faces $15B defense shortfall of $27B needed; $7B domestic, $12B EU cooperation expected (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33706)
Geran drones striking dry-cargo ships in Chernomorsk port, Bug Estuary, Black Sea; Poland and Romania refused grain assistance (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33705, @ukr_leaks_eng/33716)
